description: Choose the lowest-frequency detected peak when more than three peaks are present, even though it is the weakest.

oracle.description: The selected band contains four peaks at 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, and 0.9 Hz with powers 2, 3, 4, and 5. The empirical more-than-three branch selects 0.3 Hz rather than the 0.9 Hz global peak, giving delay 5.
